name: 16127 · Grove City, PA
findings: ZIP 16127 (Grove City) has 77 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (52% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16127 (Grove City) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
49% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.
